description: This file defines a mock class ApplicationManagementServerMock for testing purposes, which implements the IApplicationManagementServer interface. It uses Google Mock to mock methods related to application management server operations such as initialize, sendStateChangedEvent, start, and stop.

classes.name: ApplicationManagementServerMock
classes.description: Mock class implementing IApplicationManagementServer interface for testing, providing mocked methods for application management operations.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Mocks the initialization method which takes a socket descriptor.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Mocks the method to send a state changed event with a session server state parameter.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Mocks the method to start the application management server.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Mocks the method to stop the application management server.
